timeline.message:
Fix expected message in assertion

The previous attempt to fix this test introduced conditional assertion with
"shard closed" message. I believe it should be "shard is closed" as the only
cancelation string we get.
timeline.author: ievgen.degtiarenko

timeline.body:
The previous attempt to fix this test introduced conditional assertion with "shard closed" message. I believe it should be "shard is closed" as the only cancellation string we get.

Closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/96618

Original change that introduced this assertion: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/97096
Please note, the error mentioned there contains "shard is closed". 
This makes me believe that "is" was lost accidentally.
